title: G6 sensor - "G5 Sensor Requesting Restart" - now no signal
symptom: A G6 sensor used for 11 days with xDrip and a Sony Smartwatch 3 displayed 'G5 sensor requesting restart' and then no readings. Later showed 'sensor stopped' and 'Unusual session start failure, is transmitter crashed? Try Hard Reset?'.
cause: The transmitter failed, as determined after using the official Dexcom app on an iPhone and installing a new sensor.
fix: The issue was resolved by using the official Dexcom app on an iPhone and installing a new sensor, which revealed the transmitter had failed.
evidence_quote: Having fired up the official dexcom app on an iphone and installed a new sensor, it seems the transmitter has failed - only a month old.
